div.div:
Runs on the System Node Group (managed · all AZs): CoreDNS · Karpenter · KEDA · ArgoCD · Prometheus · Grafana · OpenCost · ALB Controller · External Secrets Operator
※ HPA is a built-in control-plane controller. KEDA creates and uses it via a ScaledObject

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1024px; margin-left: 6px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #545B64;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#545B64, #9aa0a8); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
· App nodes are dynamically provisioned by Karpenter starting from 0, spread across two AZs
· Actual AZ placement of pods/CronJobs is decided by the K8s scheduler (AZ shown here is a logical representation)
· Only one NAT in 2a; the 2c private subnet shares it via routing (FinOps · single ≈ $33/month vs 3, one per AZ, ≈ $99/month)
· S3/DynamoDB are accessed via VPC GW Endpoint, bypassing NAT (cost · security)
· The EKS control plane is AWS-managed and sits outside the user VPC
